If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved when the status bar shows that you have signal. Always check the status bar if the agent asks you for status information. messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there! My phone has been showing "No Service" for the past few hours, and I’m not sure what’s going on. Can you help me get it working again?

To assist you with your "No Service" issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth,
- Or your customer ID?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your service problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Thank you for providing your information. To begin troubleshooting your "No Service" issue, I’ll need you to perform a quick check on your phone:

Please look at your phone’s status bar (the area at the top of your screen) and let me know if you see any of the following:
- An airplane icon (✈️)
- A SIM card icon with an X or warning
- Any signal bars, or if it says "No Service" or "Emergency Calls Only"

This will help me determine the next steps. If you’re able to, you can also tell me if you recently changed any settings or if anything else unusual happened before you lost service.

I just checked my phone’s status bar. It shows “No Service” and I don’t see any signal bars. There’s no airplane icon, and I don’t see any SIM card icon with an X or warning either. I haven’t changed any settings or noticed anything unusual before this started happening. What should I try next?

Thank you for the details. Your line status appears active, so let’s check for common issues that could cause "No Service" even when your account is in good standing.

The next step is to check your SIM card status. Please follow these instructions on your phone:
1. Go to your phone’s settings.
2. Find the section for SIM card or Mobile Network.
3. Look for an option to check SIM status or SIM information.

Let me know what it says about your SIM card (e.g., Active, Missing, Locked, etc.). If you’re not sure how to check, let me know your phone model and I can guide you step-by-step.
The SIM card is locked with a PIN code.
It looks like my SIM card status says it’s locked with a PIN code. What should I do to unlock it?

Since your SIM card is locked with a PIN code, you’ll need to enter the correct PIN to unlock it. If you know your SIM PIN, you can enter it on your phone when prompted.

If you don’t remember your SIM PIN or have entered it incorrectly multiple times, your SIM may become blocked and require a PUK (Personal Unblocking Key) code. For security reasons, I am unable to provide or reset SIM PINs or PUK codes directly.

In this case, you will need to contact technical support for assistance with SIM security. I will transfer you to a human agent who can help you unlock your SIM.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
